Below is a concise, ready‑to‑use list of the **long‑weekend holidays in Canada for 2023**.  
The table shows the holiday name, the date it falls on in 2023, the day of the week, and the provinces/territories where the holiday is observed (or “All” for federal holidays).  A “long weekend” is defined as a holiday that either falls on a Friday or Monday (or is observed on the following Monday if it lands on a weekend), thereby giving you a 3‑day weekend.

| # | Holiday | Date (2023) | Day | Observed in | Notes |
|---|---------|-------------|-----|-------------|-------|
| 1 | New Year’s Day | Jan 1 | Sun | All | Observed Mon Jan 2 (creates 2‑day weekend) |
| 2 | Family Day (Ontario, Alberta, Saskatchewan, Manitoba) | Feb 20 | Mon | ON, AB, SK, MB | Long weekend |
| 3 | Good Friday | Apr 7 | Fri | All | Long weekend |
| 4 | Victoria Day | May 22 | Mon | All | Long weekend |
| 5 | St. Jean Baptiste Day (Quebec) | Jun 24 | Fri | QC | Long weekend |
| 6 | Canada Day | Jul 1 | Sat | All | Observed Mon Jul 3 (long weekend) |
| 7 | BC Day (British Columbia) | Aug 7 | Mon | BC | Long weekend |
| 8 | Heritage Day (Saskatchewan) | Aug 28 | Mon | SK | Long weekend |
| 9 | Labour Day | Sep 4 | Mon | All | Long weekend |
|10 | Thanksgiving | Oct 9 | Mon | All | Long weekend |
|11 | Remembrance Day | Nov 11 | Sat | All | Observed Mon Nov 13 (long weekend) |
|12 | Christmas Day | Dec 25 | Mon | All | Long weekend |

### Quick‑reference JSON (for your app)

```json
[
  {"holiday":"New Year's Day","date":"2023-01-01","observed":"2023-01-02","province":"All"},
  {"holiday":"Family Day","date":"2023-02-20","province":"ON,AB,SK,MB"},
  {"holiday":"Good Friday","date":"2023-04-07","province":"All"},
  {"holiday":"Victoria Day","date":"2023-05-22","province":"All"},
  {"holiday":"St. Jean Baptiste Day","date":"2023-06-24","province":"QC"},
  {"holiday":"Canada Day","date":"2023-07-01","observed":"2023-07-03","province":"All"},
  {"holiday":"BC Day","date":"2023-08-07","province":"BC"},
  {"holiday":"Heritage Day","date":"2023-08-28","province":"SK"},
  {"holiday":"Labour Day","date":"2023-09-04","province":"All"},
  {"holiday":"Thanksgiving","date":"2023-10-09","province":"All"},
  {"holiday":"Remembrance Day","date":"2023-11-11","observed":"2023-11-13","province":"All"},
  {"holiday":"Christmas Day","date":"2023-12-25","province":"All"}
]
```

> **Tip:** If you need province‑specific holidays beyond those listed (e.g., St. Patrick’s Day in Newfoundland & Labrador, or other regional observances), you can pull the official “Canadian Holidays” feed from the Government of Canada’s website or use the `holidays` Python package (`pip install holidays`) to generate a full calendar programmatically.

Feel free to copy the table or JSON into your holiday‑planning app. Let me know if you’d like the data in another format or need additional provincial holidays!
